services.name: Beach Cruiser
services.desc: Experience the very best of the Outer Banks shoreline on our Beach Cruiser, the perfect helicopter tour for breathtaking ocean views, iconic landmarks, and unforgettable coastal scenery. Your adventure begins as you lift off from Manteo Airport, climbing over the beautiful Virginia Dare Memorial Bridge where the sparkling waters of the Roanoke Sound meet the Atlantic. As you cross onto the barrier islands, the world-famous Jennette’s Pier comes into view, stretching nearly 1,000 feet into the Atlantic Ocean.
